text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we're piloting an "evidence binder" attached to each calibration packet this cycle. Goal: make calibration faster by surfacing 3-5 curated artifacts per person.
Eve (Eng Manager): Love the idea. What's in the binder and who curates it?
Sam (People Ops): Manager-owned. Required fields: 3 bullets max (impact artifacts), 1 metric line, and an optional 1-paragraph context note. We'll provide a tiny uploader so it's part of the packet.
Hassan (Sales Ops): For sales-aligned ICs, can we include closed-won snapshot links? Those live in CRM and have restricted access.
Sam (People Ops): Yes — include CRM links and make sure access is granted to at least "calibration" group. If link is restricted, paste a 1-line summary with ARR impact.
Nora (HRBP): Do we accept non-English artifacts? Some EMEA folks submit customer notes in French.
Sam (People Ops): Accept them. Ask for a 1-line English summary in the binder. People Ops will flag anything needing formal translation and route to localization ops.
Liam (IC): Practical question: is the binder mandatory for promotions / comp-impact cases?
Sam (People Ops): Mandatory for promotion/comp-impact flags. For everyone else it's strongly encouraged but optional. It speeds things up in exec review.
Eve (Eng Manager): Can you paste the binder template? I'll forward to my leads.
Sam (People Ops): Sure — paste this into the packet or upload as a small doc:
```
Evidence Binder (short):
- Employee: name (role)
- Top 3 artifacts (1 line each with link): 1) PR/feature link + short impact, 2) Incident postmortem or runbook, 3) Customer note or metrics dashboard
- Key metric (single line): e.g., reduced p50 latency by 20% (from 120ms -> 96ms) or $47k ARR influence
- Context blurb (1 paragraph max): 2-3 sentences with any mitigating factors (leave, transfer, partial period)
- Access notes: list of links that require special permissions
```
Nora (HRBP): Timeline notes? When do managers need to finish binders by?
Sam (People Ops): Binder deadline = manager reviews due date. Same deadline: Fri 04/15 EOD. People Ops will run a preflight check on Mon 04/18 and ping missing binders.
hr-bot: Auto-check queued: will send missing-binder reminders on 04/18 09:00 PT.
Hassan (Sales Ops): If someone has a long-running program with many artifacts, should we link a folder or just pick highlights?
Sam (People Ops): Pick highlights only. Keep it lightweight. If you attach a folder, include a 1-line index of what to look at.
Eve (Eng Manager): One more: do IC self-assessments get included in the binder or separate?
Sam (People Ops): Self-assessments remain separate but managers should pull 1-2 self-notes into the binder if they reinforce evidence. Helps with contested narratives.
Liam (IC): Thanks 44d will prep mine and ask my manager to upload.
Sam (People Ops): We'll add a short "how to" doc in the packet UI and a 20-min drop-in tomorrow for anyone who wants help curating artifacts. RSVP in the calendar invite.
Nora (HRBP): We'll mention this in the HRBP checklist too so managers get nudges during 1:1s.
Sam (People Ops): Great. If folks want a sample binder (anonymized), DM me and I'll share a redacted example. End of thread.
